State Bank of India (SBI) has released the SBI SO Recruitment 2026 notification for 220 Specialist Cadre Officer vacancies on a contract basis Oon 4th September 2026. The recruitment drive includes Zonal Head (Retail), Regional Head, Relationship Manager-Team Lead, Investment Specialist, Investment Officer, VP Wealth and AVP Wealth posts. The SBI SO apply online has started on 4th Sep 2026 and the last date to submit the application form is 25th Sep 2026. Candidates will be selected through shortlisting followed by one or more rounds of Personal, Telephonic or Video Interview and CTC negotiation. Candidates should check the post-wise vacancy, educational qualification, experience, age limit, salary, application fee and selection process before applying.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Out

State Bank of India has announced the vacancies of Specialist Cadre Officers for its Wealth Management section under Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/23. A total of 220 vacancies are released across seven posts. The appointments will be made on a contract basis and eligible candidates can submit their applications through the SBI Careers portal.

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

State Bank of India has released the detailed SBI SO Notification 2026 for the recruitment of Specialist Cadre Officers on a contract basis. The notification PDF contains details regarding post wise vacancies, age criteria, educational qualification, professional experience, CTC, contract period, application fee, online application procedure and selection process. Candidates should carefully check the eligibility criteria for the post they intend to apply for. SBI has also clarified that candidates can apply for more than one post if they fulfil all the eligibility requirements prescribed for each post.

SBI SO Notification 2026 PDF: Click to Download

SBI SO Apply Online 2026

The SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026 Apply Online process started on 4th Sep 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the SBI Careers portal until 25th Sep 2026. Candidates can apply for more than one post if they satisfy the eligibility criteria for each post. Applicants should complete registration, upload all prescribed documents and pay the applicable application fee before the closing date. Hard copies of the application form or supporting documents are not required to be sent to SBI.

SBI SO 2026 Apply Online: Direct Link Active 

How to Apply Online for SBI SO Recruitment 2026?

Candidates can submit the SBI SO Application Form 2026 through the current openings section of the official SBI Careers website.

  1. Visit the official SBI Careers website.
  2. Open the Current Openings section.
  3. Find Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/23.
  4. Read the SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026 notification carefully.
  5. Click on the Apply Online link.
  6. Complete the registration process using a valid email ID and required details.
  7. Note the provisional registration number and password generated by the system.
  8. Enter personal, educational qualification and professional experience details.
  9. Select the post for which the application is being submitted.
  10. Enter Circle preferences wherever required.
  11. Upload the photograph, signature, resume and all required supporting documents.
  12. Check all the information entered in the application form carefully.
  13. Pay the ₹750 application fee, if applicable.
  14. Submit the application form before 25th Sep 2026.
  15. Download and retain a printout of the application form and e-receipt for future reference.

Candidates should verify all details before final submission because changes or corrections may not be permitted after the application is finally submitted.

SBI SO Application Fee

Candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories have to pay ₹750 as application fee and intimation charges. SC, ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee.

Category Application Fee
UR ₹750
EWS ₹750
OBC ₹750
SC Nil
ST Nil
PwBD Nil

The fee must be paid online through the payment gateway using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking or other available online payment modes. The application fee once paid will not be refunded or adjusted against any other recruitment process.

Documents Required for SBI SO Application Form 2026

Candidates must upload the required documents while filling out the SBI Specialist Cadre Officer application form. Applications without the prescribed supporting documents may not be considered for shortlisting.

  • Recent passport-size photograph
  • Scanned signature
  • Brief Resume
  • Valid ID Proof
  • PAN Card
  • PwBD Certificate, wherever applicable
  • Educational qualification mark sheets and degree certificates
  • Experience certificates
  • Form 16, Offer Letter or latest salary slip from current employer
  • No Objection Certificate, wherever applicable
  • Bio-data and CTC Format
  • Caste or category certificate, wherever applicable

All supporting documents except the photograph and signature should generally be uploaded in PDF format. Candidates should ensure that the uploaded files are clear and readable.

Who is Eligible for SBI SO Recruitment 2026?

Candidates applying for SBI SO Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the post wise educational qualification, professional experience and age criteria. The eligibility conditions will be calculated as on 31st Aug 2026. Teaching and training experience will not be counted for determining eligibility.

SBI SO Educational Qualification 2026

Post Name Mandatory Educational Qualification
Zonal Head (Retail) Graduate from a Government recognised University or Institution
Regional Head (RH) Graduate from a Government recognised University or Institution
Relationship Manager-Team Lead Graduate from a Government recognised University or Institution
Investment Specialist (IS) PG Degree or PG Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance or Actuarial Science from a recognised institution OR CA/CFA
Investment Officer (IO) PG Degree or PG Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance or Actuarial Science from a recognised institution OR CA/CFA
VP Wealth Graduation from a Government recognised University or Institution
AVP Wealth Graduate from a Government recognised University or Institution

SBI SO Experience 2026

Post Name Mandatory Experience
Zonal Head (Retail) Minimum 15 years of experience in managing sales in Wealth Management, Retail Banking or AMCs, including minimum 5 years of experience leading a large team of Relationship Managers and Team Leads
Regional Head (RH) Minimum 12+ years of experience in relationship management, preferably in wealth management, including 5+ years of experience leading a large team of Relationship Managers or as Team Lead
Relationship Manager-Team Lead Minimum 8 years of post-qualification experience in relationship management, preferably in wealth management
Investment Specialist (IS) Minimum 6 years of post-qualification experience as Investment Advisor, Counsellor, Officer or part of a product team in Wealth Management Firms or AMCs
Investment Officer (IO) Minimum 4 years of post-qualification experience as Investment Advisor, Counsellor, Officer or part of a product team in Wealth Management Firms or AMCs
VP Wealth Minimum 6 years of experience in sales and marketing with leading Public, Private or Foreign Banks, Wealth Management Firms or AMCs
AVP Wealth Minimum 3 years of experience in sales and marketing with leading Public, Private or Foreign Banks, Wealth Management Firms or AMCs; SBI Wealth CREs require 4 years of experience

SBI SO Age Limit 2026

The SBI SO Recruitment 2026 age limit varies according to the post. Age will be calculated as on 31st Aug 2026. The maximum age shown below applies to Unreserved candidates, while relaxation in the upper age limit will be provided to eligible reserved-category candidates as per Government of India guidelines.

SBI SO 2026 Salary

SBI Specialist Officer salary is offered in the form of annual Cost to Company (CTC). The CTC varies according to the post and can be negotiated based on the candidate’s experience, current emoluments and place of posting. Selected candidates will also be eligible for Performance Linked Pay and annual increments based on performance ratings as per SBI policy.

Post Name Annual CTC Upper Range Contract Period
Zonal Head (Retail) ₹97.00 Lakh 5 Years, renewable for another 4 years at the discretion of SBI
Regional Head (RH) ₹66.40 Lakh
Relationship Manager-Team Lead ₹51.80 Lakh
Investment Specialist (IS) ₹44.50 Lakh
Investment Officer (IO) ₹27.10 Lakh
VP Wealth ₹44.70 Lakh
AVP Wealth ₹30.20 Lakh

The annual CTC upper range includes Fixed Pay, Variable Pay or Performance Linked Pay and other applicable perks. The exact CTC offered may vary depending on the candidate’s profile and negotiations with the Bank.

SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Contract Period 2026

The selected Specialist Cadre Officers will initially be engaged on a contract for five years. The contract may be renewed for another four years at the discretion of State Bank of India, subject to fulfilment of the conditions prescribed by the Bank. The contract may also be terminated by either side by giving two months’ notice or by payment or surrender of two months’ compensation in lieu of the notice period.

SBI SO Selection Process 2026

The SBI Wealth Management Selection Process 2026 does not include a written examination. Candidates will first be shortlisted based on their qualifications, professional experience, suitability and other parameters decided by SBI. Shortlisted candidates will then be called for one or more rounds of Personal, Telephonic or Video Interview followed by CTC negotiation.

  1. Shortlisting of Applications
  2. Personal/Telephonic/Video Interview
  3. CTC Negotiation
  4. Final Merit List
  5. Document Verification and other pre-engagement formalities

SBI SO Interview 2026

The SBI Specialist Officer Interview will carry 100 marks. The qualifying marks in the interview will be decided by State Bank of India. Merely satisfying the minimum educational qualification and experience requirements does not guarantee that a candidate will be called for interview.

Selection Component Details
Shortlisting Based on parameters decided by the SBI Shortlisting Committee
Interview 100 Marks
Interview Mode Personal, Telephonic and/or Video Interview
Qualifying Marks To be decided by SBI
CTC Negotiation At the time of Interview or after completion of the Interview process

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 FAQs

Ques: How many vacancies are announced under SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026?

Answer: State Bank of India has announced a total of 220 vacancies for seven Wealth Management Specialist Cadre Officer posts.

Ques: What is the last date to apply for SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026?

Answer: The last date to submit the SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026 online application form is 25th Sep 2026.

Ques: When did the SBI Wealth Management application process start?

Answer: The online application process started on 4th Sep 2026.

Ques: Which posts are available under SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026?

Answer: The recruitment includes Zonal Head (Retail), Regional Head, Relationship Manager-Team Lead, Investment Specialist, Investment Officer, VP Wealth and AVP Wealth posts.

Ques: How many SBI VP Wealth vacancies are available in 2026?

Answer: SBI has announced 91 vacancies for the VP Wealth post.

Ques: How many SBI AVP Wealth vacancies are available in 2026?

Answer: A total of 73 vacancies have been announced for the AVP Wealth post.

Ques: What is the application fee for SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026?

Answer: UR, EWS and OBC candidates have to pay ₹750. SC, ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

Ques: What is the selection process for SBI Wealth Management Recruitment 2026?

Answer: Candidates will be selected through shortlisting followed by one or more rounds of Personal, Telephonic or Video Interview and CTC negotiation.

Ques: How many marks are allotted to the SBI Wealth Management Interview?

Answer: The interview carries a total of 100 marks. The qualifying marks will be decided by State Bank of India.

Ques: What is the salary for SBI VP Wealth Recruitment 2026?

Answer: The annual CTC upper range for VP Wealth is ₹44.70 lakh.

Ques: What is the contract period for SBI Wealth Management posts?

Answer: The initial contract period is five years and may be renewed for another four years at the discretion of SBI, subject to the prescribed conditions.

Ques: Can candidates apply for more than one SBI Wealth Management post?

Answer: Yes. Candidates can apply for more than one post if they meet all the eligibility criteria prescribed for each post.
